content.short: HBS Blockchain and Crypto Club provides focused on career development in the blockchain and crypto space.
content.description: HBS Blockchain and Crypto Club provides educational resources and meaningful networking opportunities for Harvard Business School students interested in blockchain and cryptocurrency. The group aims to bridge traditional finance and the growing crypto ecosystem by organizing events with industry professionals and offering avenues for internships and full-time roles. Members learn about blockchain applications, crypto markets, and related career paths through seminars, panel discussions, and hands-on activities, helping them pursue careers in the blockchain field.
